description: Restrospective application for change of use of Plot J for the temporary use as a sales and marketing suite and restaurant (sui generis) with ancillary storage space and associated landscaping for a period of 8 years
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The retention of the building as a sales/ marketing suite and restaurant with ancillary storage space and associated landscaping hereby approved shall be initially permitted for a maximum of five years from the date of this decision notice.  
Permission for continued temporary use of the building for the above described purposes beyond a five year period from the date of this decision notice shall only be granted subject to the submission and approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority of an acceptable implementation strategy update report prior to this date.  
This implementation strategy update report shall demonstrate progress made in delivery of the Land South of Brentford High Street development to the date of writing and propose a realistic projected timescale for the implementation of remaining phases.  It shall include details regarding implementation of the development phase in which the subject site is located.  
Notwithstanding this requirement, the temporary uses of the building hereby approved shall in all circumstances cease entirely and the building be vacated and returned to its condition by removal of the balcony, external staircase and extractor flue to the east elevation within five years from the date of this decision notice, or eight years if a further extension is permitted as above.

Condition : 3 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the mechanical system etc operates. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance with the latest British Standard 4142; An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are met. 
b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.
c) Within three months of the date of this permission, or before the premises re-open following relaxation of the COVID19 restrictions  installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be carried out by a suitably qualified noise consultant who is a member of either The Association of Noise Consultants or the Institute of Acoustics who will certify  that the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions conforms to part a) above. If the initial test results fail to meet these criteria, the applicants shall adapt the installation so that it does and then commission a repeat test. The assessment shall follow the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. Condition : 4 - The sales/ marketing unit hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 09.00 to 18.00 Monday to Sunday and 09.00 to 11.00 Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 5 - Waste and recycling materials shall only be stored within the annotated store included in the approved plan HAL-ZZ-00-DR-A-GAP-100 (Rev P12).  No waste or recycled materials shall be stored or placed on the public highway or footway at any time apart from specific collection times, following which bins shall be returned to the designated off-street storage area without delay.
